Zerbaxa became the first drug reimbursed under the expanded exemption, paired with a capped revenue-sharing agreement.

ko.inner: 무엇을 하지 않을지 고른 사례. 적응증을 포기해 약가를 지켰다.

en.inner: InterventionProphylaxis was stopping too early in HSCT patients, often from misconceptions or off-guideline, customary practice. Correcting that took a developed narrative and heavy HCP, marketing, and sales education, lifting average duration of therapy (DOT) on the 100-day indication from 55% to 80%.

ko.inner: 개입조혈모세포이식 환자에서 예방요법이 일찍 중단되는 경우가 많았다. 오해나 가이드라인과 어긋난 관행적 처치가 원인이었다. 이를 교정하기 위해 내러티브를 개발하고 의료진·마케팅·세일즈 교육을 극대화해, 100일 적응증의 평균 DOT를 55%에서 80%로 끌어올렸다.

en.inner: The judgmentThe 200-day expansion is a separate lever, and the two compound. At 55% DOT, even a doubled course reaches only ~110 days (in practice, less), so the 200-day extension pays off only when the base DOT is high. Meanwhile, broadening indications risked a price cut. Modeling the scenarios and pulling field insight from the transplant and hematology sites, the low-value kidney-transplant indication was deliberately dropped to protect price and concentrate every resource on the 200-day HSCT expansion, a decision about what not to pursue.

ko.inner: 판단200일 확대는 별개의 레버이고, 둘은 맞물린다. DOT 55%면 두 배로 늘려도 실제 투여는 약 110일(실제론 더 낮음)에 그쳐, 기저 DOT가 높아야 200일 확대의 비즈니스 임팩트가 산다. 한편 적응증을 넓히면 약가 인하 위험이 커진다. 시나리오를 시뮬레이션하고 이식·혈액내과 현장에서 필드 인사이트를 받아, 시장성 낮은 신장이식(KT) 적응증을 전략적으로 포기했다. 약가를 지키고 모든 자원을 200일 HSCT 확대에 집중하기 위한, "무엇을 하지 않을 것인가"의 결정이었다.

en.inner: The payoffOver two years the call paid off: indication expansion approved (2024) and reimbursement secured (2025) on a self-authored dossier, defending price and protecting profitability.

ko.inner: 결실판단은 2년 뒤 성과로 돌아왔다. 자체 보고서만으로 적응증 확대 승인(2024)과 급여 확대(2025)를 받아냈고 약가와 수익성을 지켰다.

en.inner: The same pillar, at BIThe value-and-access instinct recurs on MASLD/MASH: an evidence-gap analysis feeding an ICER-report advisory board (Dec 2025) that aligned stakeholders on Korea's epidemiology and HEOR gaps, setting the reimbursement value story before launch, this time by building the case, not trading indications.

ko.inner: 같은 필러, BI에서같은 value·access 감각이 MASLD/MASH에서 이어진다. evidence-gap analysis를 ICER 리포트 기반 ABM(2025.12)으로 연결해 한국의 역학·HEOR 근거 공백에 대해 stakeholder를 정렬하고, 런칭 전에 급여 가치 서사를 세웠다. 이번에는 적응증을 맞바꾸는 대신 근거를 쌓아 올리는 방식이었다.

en.inner: The analysisBehind the three MOUs is a systems analysis, not a hunch. Undiagnosed MASH maps as four reinforcing failure loops, public awareness, screening blindness, primary-care inertia, tertiary hepatology bias, each matched to a leverage point: 365mc (awareness), KMI (screening), Philips (diagnosis). It was written up as a strategic blueprint that doubled as a Johns Hopkins MPH practicum.

en.inner: An encore, as a scientific peer
The Liver Week 2026, standing on the plenary stage as a peer to the clinical investigators, not a data-forwarder.

en.inner: The momentEarly one Monday, Boehringer Ingelheim's MASLD data was presented at its original congress (ADA). Roughly 100 hours later came its encore, a (non-sponsored) plenary of The Liver Week, an abstract selected for plenary and the only session in that block.

ko.inner: 순간어느 월요일 이른 아침, Boehringer Ingelheim의 MASLD 데이터가 original congress인 ADA에서 발표됐다. 약 100시간 뒤 The Liver Week의 비후원 Plenary에서 그 encore가 이어졌다. Plenary로 뽑힌 초록이었고 그 시간대의 유일한 세션이었다.

en.inner: The strategyBefore approval there is no marketing, so pre-launch activity rests on the medical and scientific team. Reframed as a model: encore abstracts over costly satellite symposia, six congresses planned this year (KSSO, SOMS, The Liver Week in 1H; three Korea-based international congresses in 2H), all abstracts confirmed, with some orals delivered by trained MSLs.

ko.inner: 전략허가 전에는 마케팅이 없으니 pre-launch 활동은 메디컬·과학팀에 달려 있다. 이를 하나의 모델로 정리했다. 비싼 satellite symposium 대신 encore 초록. 올해 여섯 학회를 계획했고(1H: KSSO·SOMS·The Liver Week / 2H: 한국 소재 국제학술대회 3개) 초록 투고는 모두 확정됐다. 일부 구두 발표는 교육한 MSL이 맡는다.

en.inner: Why HQ collaboration matteredThis runs on close headquarters collaboration, not just forwarding data, but pre-coordinating with the academic society, and because HQ will not stage a presentation like this without a principal investigator. Here the study had no Korean PI, which is exactly what made this route possible; a PI would have made it harder, not easier.

ko.inner: 본사 협업이 관건인 이유이 작업은 본사와의 긴밀한 협업으로 돌아간다. 자료만 전달하고 끝이 아니라 학회와 사전에 조율할 게 많고, 본사는 PI가 아니면 이런 발표를 세우지 않는다. 이 연구는 한국에 PI가 없었는데, 오히려 그 점이 이 방식을 가능하게 했다. PI가 있었다면 더 어려웠을 것이다.

en.inner: The departureThe point isn't speed. Korean Medical Affairs has largely stayed a data-forwarding function, working pre-authorized topics; standing on a plenary stage as a scientific peer to the clinical investigators, owning the science rather than relaying it, and executing the encore that way, is the break from that norm.

en.inner: The full-stack viewGenerating evidence is the easy half; the point is use, how it moves clinical practice and the business. Inferring that means owning everything from the synopsis: cohort selection, process, not just the analysis. "Garbage in, garbage out," statisticians say, yet good analysis on good data still is not always useful. The payoff usually lands on one of three axes: approval, reimbursement, or clinical positioning, and reading which one takes the full scope. It isn't statistics alone, nor clinical training alone; designing RWE that actually delivers value fuses public health, health economics, policy, clinical science, real clinical practice, and epidemiology, sharpened by a Johns Hopkins MPH, many pre-launch cycles, and a fiercely competitive pharma market.

That started with a pediatric-CPR loop that had to work no matter who was on shift.

ko.inner: 무언가 무너졌을 때 개인을 탓하는 건 대개 잘못된 독법이다. 바꿔야 할 것은 그 아래, 시스템에 있다. 그리고 관리자에게는 그에 대한 책임이 있다. 팀을 탓하는 대신, 시스템이 요구하는 수준까지 팀이 '준비'되도록 교육하는 관리의 책임이다. 누가 당직이든 돌아가야 했던 소아 CPR 교육 과정에서 시작된 생각이다.

en.inner: Talk is cheap. Working on inertia while narrating it as something grand, taking verbal credit for others' results or for outcomes you were simply supposed to deliver, dressing a meaningless output as an achievement, none of that is the work. Show what actually shipped.
